title: Maximum Number of Equal Length Runs
summary: Given a string of lowercase English letters, identify runs of equal letters.
statement: Given a string of lowercase English letters, identify runs of equal letters. Select runs of the same length. Return the highest count of such selected runs.
constraints: A run is a maximal consecutive block of one repeated character.
Group runs by their lengths and return the greatest group size.
hints: First identify maximal runs, independent of which character forms them.
Count how often each run length occurs.
Scan change points, increment the completed run length, and return the largest frequency.
Every maximal run ends at exactly one change point or the end of the string.
editorial: Every maximal run ends at exactly one change point or the end of the string.

tests.explanation: The runs h, e, ll, and o have lengths 1,1,2,1; length one occurs three times.
Run lengths are three, two, four, and two, so two runs share the most common length.
